storage.problem.corrupted: The data file was damaged and has been moved aside; the application started with an empty list. You can restore your entries from the backup (.bak) next to it or by syncing with the cloud.
storage.problem.newerVersion: The data file was saved by a newer version of Stapik Media. Update the application. The file has not been changed and editing is disabled.
storage.problem.migrationFailed: The data file could not be converted to the current format. The file has not been changed and editing is disabled.
partition.notLoaded.message: Entries from that year are stored in a cloud archive that has not been downloaded yet. Select the year in the filter first to load it, then try again.
dialog.backup.restoreFailed.title: The backup could not be restored
dialog.backup.restoreFailed.text: The file is unreadable or was written by a newer version of Stapik Media.
dialog.save.failed.title: The media list could not be saved
dialog.save.failed.text: Your changes stay in the open window but are not on disk: {error}
dialog.disconnect.title: Disconnect from cloud?
dialog.disconnect.message: The API key and the connection settings will be removed from this device. The media list on this device and in the cloud stays as it is.
cloud.conflict.secondary: Another device saved a newer version of the media list. Your latest changes were replaced by it.
cloud.plainFileSecrets: No system keyring is available, so the API key and the passphrase are kept in a file readable only by your user.
